$comment: Declarative slice list for the Modern Interiors pack (LimeZu).
Paths are relative to pack_root. Geometry here is MEASURED, not assumed --
see tools/atlas/README.md for how each number was verified.
This file contains no pixels, only coordinates, so it is safe to commit.
The atlases it produces are NOT safe to commit; see .gitignore.
Layer order is the pack's documented BODY > EYES > OUTFIT > HAIRSTYLE >
ACCESSORY (CHARACTER_GENERATOR.txt). A premade collapses the first four,
so only the accessory is layered on top. Keeping this a list rather than a
single flattened file is what preserves the option of customization later.
The base layer is now a custom composite (assets/2_Characters/sprite_female.png,
built by assets/2_Characters/generator.html from raw Body+Outfit+Hairstyle
layers) rather than a pack Premade. That sheet ships at the pack's 32x32
tier (Bodies-family width 927x2=1854), so sprite_female_16x16.png is a
checked-in-by-hand nearest-neighbour 2x downscale of it, cropped from 927
to 896 wide to match the Accessory layer's canvas (only unused trailing
padding is lost -- every animation column the manifest below uses is
within 0..896). This one layer is the exception to 'nothing here hardcodes
a sprite': regenerating it means re-running that downscale+crop, not just
re-running build_atlases.py.
$directions_comment: Column blocks run counter-clockwise from east: right, up, left, down.
Verified with the gift row, where the held box sits right of the body in
block 0 and left of it in block 2. Spec 14 claimed down/up/left/right;
using that order silently swaps the baker's facing.

$comment: Fixtures whose animation carries the 'something is baking' signal (05).
The full room fixture list is deliberately absent: it is a layout task
gated on the per-device room dimensions from 01.
The 16x16 tier ships no PNG spritesheet for fridge_cake_1 -- only a
GIF, which the builder does not read. The _2 variant is the same
12 frames of the same cabinet with a different cake inside.
PROVISIONAL. The final 5-6 recipes are an open question in 07; these are
the pack's most legible standalone treats at 16x16, which is the order 07
asks for (pick from what the pack renders well, not names first).
Theme folder names are just the pack's sorting -- 'Christmas' cookies are
not seasonally styled. Singles are numbered identically across the pack's
resolution tiers, so these are the same sprites the 32x32 build picked.
'SIngles' in the Christmas paths is the pack's typo, not ours.
